oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: prod-cluster-02 GPU node restarting pods repeatedly. Auto-pager routed to @tanvi (oncall). Incident ID INC-7892

 tanvi: seeing repeated container restarts on inference-pool-02 (node-02). Dashboard shows a spike in prefill memory usage and then container SIGKILL. Paging now.

 mike: on it, joining. Any obvious customer 503 spikes?

 tanvi: yes — two routes showing elevated 5xx: /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings for tenant chat-pro and search-app. CS alerted.

 ben: logs from the pod (inference-12) show CUDA OOM during prefill KV allocation. 

 eng-runtime: paste of tail logs: ```
[2026-03-15T03:21:44Z] model-serving[pid=4321]: prefill: token_count=41024 kv_alloc=3.8GiB
[2026-03-15T03:21:45Z] model-serving[pid=4321]: ERROR cuda: out of memory when allocating 1.2GiB
[2026-03-15T03:21:45Z] kernel: Container exited with signal 9
```

 saran: (typo) sorry — sarah: noted. That sequence length (41k tokens) is larger than our typical max. Was this one request or streaming aggregation?

 tanvi: single large user prompt from chat-pro — user pasted a full document + context. Prefill attempted full KV caching and blew GPU memory.

 mike: are we hitting fragmented GPU memory? Any CUDA driver resets?

 ben: kernel output shows a driver reset on node-02 right after the OOM: "NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus" — likely driver-level reaction after OOM.

 eng-runtime: checking node metrics: node-02 GPU mem went to 100% then node became unresponsive for ~90s; kubelet restarted pods. This correlates with the customer 503 window.

 tanvi: mitigation plan (live): 1) route new requests for chat-pro/search-app to spare dedicated pool (inference-pool-03) 2) cordon node-02 and drain problematic pods 3) temporarily enable stream-trim (prefix trimming) for chat-pro to avoid full prefill KV caching 4) scale up small-model fallback q4 (lower mem profile)

 cust-sre: customer impact: chat-pro reports ~3 minutes of 5xx for a small % of users (internal ticket CS-4821). Search-app saw higher error rate for embedding requests. We're notifying customers.

 mike: executing routing change: `./scripts/update-route.sh --route chat-pro --to inference-pool-03` (applied) — confirm?

 eng-runtime: routing change accepted by control plane, traffic shifting over 30s. Monitoring shows 5xx on chat-pro dropping to baseline.

 ben: cordoning node now: `kubectl cordon node-02` -> `kubectl drain node-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m` (started). Pod evictions in progress.

 tanvi: enable stream-trim flag for chat-pro via runtime config: `PATCH /admin/config chat-pro {\"prefill_trim\": true}` — applied. This will trim prefix > 8k tokens by default.

 eng-runtime: note: trimming will change outputs for very long-context callers. We warned CS.

 mike: scaled fallback pool: `replicas: +4` for model q4-small, and traffic steering rule added for requests with context > 8k.

 ben: after drain, node-02 shows freed GPU memory, no further driver resets in the last 10m. Pod restarts reduced to normal churn.

 tanvi: immediate customer-facing summary (to CS): short outage for chat-pro/search-app due to a single large prefill that exhausted GPU memory and caused driver reset -> container restarts -> elevated 5xx for ~3m. Mitigations: traffic reroute, node cordon/drain, enabled prefill trimming and fallback model.

 cust-sre: posted to CS ticket with timeline and remediation steps. Customer accepted the mitigations and requested a root cause postmortem.

 ben: flagged for follow-up: 1) examine why prefill KV allocation didn't cap earlier 2) consider enforcing hard prefill token limits at the gateway 3) check fragmentation and driver reset root cause (possible older driver on node pool-02).

 eng-runtime: quick check: node-02 GPU driver version is 520.61, other pools running 525.x. We'll tag as possible contributor.

 mike: handoff notes for morning: node-02 currently cordoned and scheduled for reprovision (drivers + cuda patch). Fallback routing and trimming remain enabled for affected tenants. We should: - run a simulated large-prefill test in staging against the same driver - add a control-plane guardrail to reject prefill > 50k tokens or route to coldmodel automatically - schedule postmortem with CS and runtime oncall.

 tanvi: handing off to @mike for postmortem and to @ben for driver investigation. I'm going to log the incident as sev-2 and mark for 72h follow-up.

 mike: acknowledged — I'll take the postmortem and coordinate kernel/driver upgrade, and create an action list.

 ben: I'll take driver/kernel diagnostics and file infra ticket INFRA-3322 for node pool remediation.

 tanvi: final note before sign-off: no data exfiltration, single-tenant heavy request triggered it, mitigations returned service to normal within 6 minutes of first alert. Passing to morning SRE with this thread.

 oncall-bot: Incident INC-7892 updated: status -> mitigated, owner -> mike, severity -> SEV-2, follow-ups assigned (mike, ben).

 tanvi: thanks team. I'm leaving a runbook edit request: make prefill_trim toggles available per-tenant and add a hard prefill threshold to control plane.

 mike: noted. Will include in postmortem actions. Handoff complete.
